changelogCoverage.item: Added MCP tool result persistence override via `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation (up to 500K), allowing larger results like DB schemas to pass through without truncation
Added `disableSkillShellExecution` setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands
Added support for multi-line prompts in `claude-cli://open?q=` deep links (encoded newlines `%0A` no longer rejected)
Plugins can now ship executables under `bin/` and invoke them as bare commands from the Bash tool
changelogCoverage.evidence: plugin bin/ PATH already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed transcript chain breaks on `--resume` that could lose conversation history when async transcript writes fail silently
Fixed `cmd+delete` not deleting to start of line on iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty, and Windows Terminal
Fixed plan mode in remote sessions losing track of the plan file after a container restart, which caused permission prompts on plan edits and an empty plan-approval modal
changelogCoverage.evidence: remote plan-file tracking already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed JSON schema validation for `permissions.defaultMode: "auto"` in settings.json
changelogCoverage.evidence: settings defaultMode auto already in types

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed Windows version cleanup not protecting the active version's rollback copy
changelogCoverage.evidence: Windows version cleanup already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: `/feedback` now explains why it's unavailable instead of disappearing from the slash menu
changelogCoverage.evidence: src/commands/feedback unavailable copy already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Improved `/claude-api` skill guidance for agent design patterns including tool surface decisions, context management, and caching strategy
changelogCoverage.evidence: bundled claude-api skill already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Improved performance: faster `stripAnsi` on Bun by routing through `Bun.stripANSI`
Edit tool now uses shorter `old_string` anchors, reducing output tokens
